punchline: Csikszentmihalyi beeped people at random times and found flow came more often at work than in free time, even though they wished to be elsewhere.
thirty_sec: Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi gave people pagers that beeped at random times. Each time, they wrote down what they were doing and how they felt. People reported flow more often at work than in free time, yet at work they more often wished to be elsewhere. His explanation is a balance of challenge and skill: too much challenge brings anxiety, too little brings boredom.
